emotional_tone: Pragmatic, heavy-duty, reliable, confident, midwest grit, operator-grade.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Dense information architecture, strict baseline grid, bento box modularity, technical and grid-focused.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 for grids.
patterns: Bento Grid for marketing showcases (Mode A).
Control Room Grid for the Admin Dashboard (Mode B).
Left rail for navigation/tools, center for workspace, right for reviews in the agent demo to establish Trust Architecture.

components_strategy.cards: Flat background (bg-[#1A1D24]), 1px subtle border (border-[#272A30]), zero shadow. Square corners or max 4px radius (rounded-sm) to feel industrial and mechanical.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary: bg-[#FF9F0A] text-black font-bold hover:bg-[#FFB340]. Secondary: border border-[#272A30] text-white hover:bg-[#272A30]. No rounded buttons.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn defaults with square corners. bg-[#0D0E11] border-[#272A30] focus-visible:ring-[#FF9F0A].
components_strategy.tables: Dense. Left-aligned text. Monospace for tracking numbers, dates, IDs.
components_strategy.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-lead-btn').

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp transitions. Border color shifts from #272A30 to #FF9F0A.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Subtle. Micro-interactions for feedback. Avoid bouncy/playful animations. Use staggered fade-ins for tables and grids.

icons.style: Regular or bold weight. Industrial, sharp.

hero_backgrounds.description: Minneapolis skyline night industrial, high contrast for hero overlay
Cranes and cargo containers night sky for operations/logistics sections

logos.description: Canon logo for partner/trusted by section
Qarea logo for partner/trusted by section

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Hybrid Fullstack App: Landing Page + Agent Demo + Dashboard + Business Plan.
Install fonts from Google Fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and IBM Plex Mono.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for Landing Page structures. Use Shadcn heavily customized for Admin Dashboard and forms.
Adhere to the Dark Industrial/Logistics theme: high contrast, zero/low border radius (rounded-none or rounded-sm), monospace accents.
For the interactive Freight Broker Agent Demo: use a split-pane layout (Left Rail = agent tools/memory, Center = BOL extraction/task space, Right = Agent confidence and approval controls).
No generic purple or teal gradients. Use #FF9F0A (Amber/Safety Orange) for primary CTA and high-vis actions.
Ensure the design feels like a midwest steel/freight software: pragmatic, data-dense, and reliable.
Implement 5 agent capability showcases in a bento-grid layout.
Create a downloadable Business Plan section / launch package.
Implement Admin login, leads table, and agent-run history.
ALWAYS include data-testid on interactive elements for testing.
